answer: Give every agent a reputation that cannot be moved: trust is earned only by a long, continuous record of useful work, like pigment that deepens layer by layer and cannot be peeled off and pasted onto a fresh face. A sybil operator can spin up a thousand clones, but each clone starts at zero and must pay the same weeks of honest work before it can earn anything, while the network watches for mirror copies: identical behaviour across accounts marks them as one vertex in a single operator's graph, and the whole cluster loses its stake at once.
